title: ID0437203-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/SD314015297001] Stuck charging session
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
At the Desenzano del Garda location (station ID: 314015297001), there has been an active "stuck charging session" for approximately 16 hours, preventing me from terminating it. One of the sockets remains in standby mode.I performed a reboot of the station, but the charging session still appears active. The station is operational, but one socket is still in standby status.I have attached a screenshot showing the error for your reference.Could you please check the system and restore the correct status?
